reference_sql:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event from 1 to 30 November 2025
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS session_engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
), sessions AS (
  -- one row per session with both IDs
  SELECT source, medium, session_engaged
  FROM starts
  WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT source, medium, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_engaged = '1') AS engaged_sessions,
  CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_engaged = '1') AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS engagement_rate
FROM sessions
GROUP BY source, medium
alternatives:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event from 1 to 30 November 2025
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, user_pseudo_id,
    [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] AS ga_session_id,
    [p.value.string_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'session_engaged'][1] AS session_engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
)
SELECT source, medium,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR)) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR) END) AS engaged_sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR) END) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR)) AS engagement_rate
FROM starts
WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY source, medium

SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged_sessions,
  AVG(CASE WHEN list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value = '1' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS engagement_rate
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
  AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY traffic_source.source, traffic_source.medium

solver.query:
WITH ss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, user_pseudo_id, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS sid, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'page_location')[1].value.string_value AS page_location, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS engaged, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_number')[1].value.int_value AS snum,
    traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, device.category AS device_category
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT source, medium, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engaged = '1') AS engaged_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engaged = '1') * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS engagement_rate
FROM ss GROUP BY source, medium
